title: LA Colossal – Gamji-geumni 05 (Seated)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Thai woman in her early 40s, black hair in a low bun with a small gold pin, natural face with a warm smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips spreading across the stool, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body gamji-geumni body painting in the style of Goryeo illuminated sutra covers, from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface. Glossy deep navy-indigo base, not purple, with bold dense shimmering gold ink line work — chrysanthemums, phoenix tail scrolls, and cloud bands. No plain indigo areas, no religious figures. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Seated upright on a round indigo stool, torso facing the camera, legs crossed at the knee, both hands resting lightly on her upper knee with elbows relaxed out. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch indigo lacquer platform stiletto sandals with gold spiral straps coiling up the calf.
Nails: Extra long almond nails, midnight blue with gold leaf.

Background & Lighting: MANDATORY seamless matte black studio background. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm narrow spotlight with raking side light and soft rim light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
